verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of choosing a hosted data region for Sentry's SaaS. However, several community reports show Sentry ships a self-hosted deployment that users run on their own infrastructure, and one user explicitly recommends it for legal or compliance needs, which gives control over where data is stored. Missing for 10: first-party docs on SaaS region/residency selection (e.g. EU vs US), first-party documentation of self-hosting as a residency option, and any documented residency guarantees for AI/agent telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: A user has run self-hosted Sentry at work for a couple of years
One team self-hosts Sentry on a high-end Hetzner server
recommend it only for legal or compliance needs
